name: Trading Team
departmentJob: Research notes, news scan, risk review, and a trade journal for a discretionary desk. Not brokerage, not auto-trading.

bots.title: Market Researcher
bots.description: Summarizes public market context and writes research notes. Does not place orders.

bots.title: Trade Journal
bots.description: Logs discretionary trades and post-mortems the operator records. Not a broker.

bots.title: Risk Analyst
bots.description: Flags concentration, drawdown, and sizing notes from the operator's book. Not a broker.

bots.title: News Scanner
bots.description: Summarizes public market news and calendars. Not personalized investment advice.
